prompt: A composite of two layers, and the contrast between them is the point. The render layer never pretends to be photographic and the photograph is never retouched to look rendered; the two meet at a hard seam. Two ordinary unbranded phones lying face up on a real formica table top, photographed from directly above in available light. Rising out of each screen is a flat shaded amber polygon nugget half, hard faceted, one blown out specular each, and a single hard phosphor green line drawn straight between them across the table. A black and white checkerboard plane runs out from under the phones and stops at a hard straight seam where the real formica continues. Top down, symmetrical, with a lot of empty table around the pair. 16:9 widescreen composition suitable for a slide, with the centre kept uncluttered. No text, no lettering, no numerals, no watermarks, no logos, no brand marks or trade dress of any kind, no recognisable real-world storefront, no identifiable faces.
